name: Newcastle-Ottawa Scale
license_note: Domain names and prompts are paraphrases. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: Domain-level star counts for cohort or case-control studies. The third domain covers outcome (cohort) or exposure (case-control). No overall judgement is derived; a star total is reported as a count.

domains.name: Selection
domains.short_prompt: How the exposed and non-exposed groups (or cases and controls) were selected.

signalling.prompt: Was the exposed cohort (or case group) representative of the target population?
Was the non-exposed cohort (or control group) drawn from the same population?
Was exposure status ascertained from a secure record or structured interview?
Was the outcome absent at the start (cohort), or were controls clearly defined (case-control)?

domains.name: Comparability
domains.short_prompt: Whether the design or analysis controlled for the most important confounders.

signalling.prompt: Did the design or analysis control for the most important factor?
Did it also control for a second relevant factor?

domains.name: Outcome or exposure
domains.short_prompt: How the outcome (cohort) or exposure (case-control) was assessed and whether follow-up was adequate.

signalling.prompt: Was the outcome assessed independently or through record linkage (cohort), or was exposure ascertained blinded (case-control)?
Was follow-up long enough for the outcome (cohort), or was the same method used for cases and controls?
Was follow-up complete, or was the non-response rate low?
